opening: Hi there! This is Sarah from Wanderlust Travels. I noticed you were looking for travel packages. I'd love to help you plan an amazing trip!
qualification_questions: Where are you thinking of traveling to?
When are you planning to go, and for how many days?
How many people will be traveling? Is it a family trip, couple's getaway, or solo adventure?
Do you have a budget range in mind for this trip?
Have you traveled internationally before, or is this your first time?

objection_handling.response: I completely understand budget is important. We actually have several affordable packages and flexible payment options. Let me find something that fits your budget perfectly.

objection_handling.objection: I need to think about it
objection_handling.response: Of course, take your time! Can I send you a detailed itinerary with pricing so you have everything to discuss with your family?
No problem at all! Many of our best travelers started by just exploring options. Can I quickly understand what kind of trips interest you so I can send you some inspiration?
You absolutely can! But with us, you get a dedicated travel planner, better hotel rates, visa assistance, and 24/7 support during your trip. Let me show you the value we add.

closing: Thank you so much for your time! I'll put together some amazing options for you and send them over. When would be a good time to connect again to finalize the plan?
